proposal.rule: The accepted radial/theta widen improved correspondence without fixing left-ring joints, so do not override that gate and do not refit the centre curve. Faint joints on the leading rings are f_joint_oversmoothed: the outlier map never forms a line there, the oblique detector already failed to extend them, and the horizontal fallback barely fires, so prompts stay propagated and correspondence stays near 0.32. Lower curvature_threshold so those joints are enhanced, and lower only hough_threshold_horizontal so near-horizontal votes can form. Do not lower the oblique threshold or raise maxLineGap again, and do not move slice spacing or the vertical threshold.
proposal.rationale: curvature_threshold 0.0003 is inside [0.0002, 0.002] and below the ontology default 0.0005, so faint leading-ring joints are kept instead of smoothed away. hough_threshold_horizontal 32 is inside [20, 60] and only relaxes the fallback that is currently two right-side stubs; it is not the oblique threshold of 30 that was rejected in round 1. The accepted denoise keys (mask_r_low 2.73, mask_r_high 3.1, mask_theta_low 1.25, mask_theta_high 18.0) are left in place.
